worker: notebook launches a new Python interpreter for every phase; guard requires recorded parent PID equals actual parent PID. Phase B is never run in the notebook interpreter.
phase_layout: phase_A, phase_B, phase_C each has immutable attempt, separate native Recorder, summary, manifest and NAS archive. C reads only sealed B artifacts and never resumes B.
source_read_order: Initialize Qlib and load all verified read-only source objects before a writable R.start. Persist prepared native objects only within the new R.start. Seal and archive after it ends.

phase_A.capture_count_semantics: Exactly four opaque source price-blob captures/materializations. Every full byte access and SHA is disclosed; copies serialized as Recorder evidence are opaque byte preservation, not numerical price decoding. Seven whitelisted provider members, two source metadata objects and two same-commit builder code objects; no omitted source members inferred.
phase_A.readonly: All materialized provider files and directories are made read-only. No price values or train label objects decoded in phase A.
phase_A.basis_gate: metadata exact comparison plus pinned same-commit code evidence. Independent economic basis review required before B; near-one coefficients are not an acceptance criterion.

phase_B.calendar: One complete native calendar metadata call; it can include dates beyond 2022. No future price is read on this account.
phase_B.internal_access: D.features may internally consult calendar/instrument/provider index metadata. Those implementation calls are disclosed and not claimed to be additional research queries or hidden price reads. The binding price boundary is the patched FileFeatureStorage __getitem__ guard, which accepts exactly one slice for each of four admitted fields wholly inside fixed native indices for 2011-01-03..2022-12-30.
phase_B.cache: Fresh interpreter; expression_cache=None,dataset_cache=None,default_disk_cache=0,features(disk_cache=0),kernels=1. Only raw $open/$close; no Ref/rolling expansion.
phase_B.axis: Qlib instrument,datetime output is reordered to datetime,instrument without value conversion; original float32 dtype remains.
phase_B.reference: Only exact PG inputs/training_dataset and inputs/training_audit are unpickled. Entire admitted 85-column train-only object is resident; selection does not pretend to prevent residency. Prior accepted whole-resident train-only audit is reused. No full-period or eval object.
phase_B.H1: Selected-source float32 divide then subtract float32(1) is paired with immutable original H1. Count/max difference only; no numerical gate or source reselection.
phase_B.identity_after_access: Opaque snapshot member SHA256 and original PG artifact bytes rechecked after bounded-price Dataset construction. Full opaque hashing before/after does not decode future prices; both accesses are disclosed separately from guarded value reads.

phase_C.input: Only B Recorder native Dataset, basis certificate, H5 mapping and immutable reference; zero D.features and no source price-bin decode.
phase_C.floating_contract: Scalar binary64 separate operations; finite inputs/intermediates/thresholds, round-to-nearest-even and gradual-underflow sanity checks, no FMA/reassociation. 44 leaves relative/22 asset; nonnegative L1 leftfold (<=43 additions), numerator=43*u, denominator=1-numerator, gamma=numerator/denominator, product=gamma*L1, allowance=43*eta, threshold=product+allowance. No nonfinite/vacuous threshold pass.
phase_C.labels: S/Z and original reference fields live in separate Dataset groups; original H1/H5 arrays and maturity retained exactly.

native_persistence: DataHandlerLP.from_df -> DatasetH; config(dump_all=True,recursive=True); all-group CS_RAW with nlevels=2; direct pickle and Recorder-load prepare roundtrip; never setup_data.
state: No existing phase run_state may be overwritten or implicitly resumed. Any real failure preserves source snapshot/RID/attempt and requires separate repair identity and owner approval.

phase_owner_approval_schema.upstream: B/C only: accepted preceding result binding_fields plus review_sha256; not inferred from elapsed time

scientific_decision: Only source/label qualification. No IC/AUC/forecast MSE, annual return screening, sign/threshold/source search, models, accounts or promotion.

date_semantics.A: Whole selected opaque source-member bytes are captured without numerical price decoding.
date_semantics.B_C: Numerical prices and derived labels stay in the fixed bounded training domain; snapshot date does not authorize later price values.
